mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS periodId, p.title, p.year, p.total_amount AS totalAmount, p.used_amount AS usedAmount, (p.total_amount - p.used_amount) AS remainAmount, ROUND(p.used_amount / NULLIF(p.total_amount, 0) * 100, 2) AS executionRate, p.start_date AS startDate, p.end_date AS endDate, p.description, p.status, p.public_time AS publicTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget_item i WHERE i.period_id = p.id AND i.deleted = 0) AS itemCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget_apply a WHERE a.period_id = p.id AND a.deleted = 0) AS applyCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget_expense e WHERE e.period_id = p.id AND e.deleted = 0) AS expenseCount FROM budget_period p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0
